source_snapshot.procedure: Login to BMC WebUI, open 2FA, privately scan the QR and secure backup code, log out, then login with username/password and the current authenticator verification code.
source_snapshot.criteria: Correct verification code permits login and navigation to Overview.
source_snapshot.script: No Master command; 5 attended/5 machine minutes; unique row/code/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; identifies state-changing enrollment and login verification with lockout/recovery risk but does not protect all secret artifacts or bind account/policy/final state.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/CRITICAL; requires operator-only QR/seed/password/OTP handling, dedicated test account, clock policy, independent recovery and non-secret evidence.

old_problem: The historical review left a well-defined positive 2FA enrollment/login flow pending for test-account, factor, clock, recovery and final-state details even though these can be signed runtime security parameters while keeping all secrets operator-only.
disposition_reason: The source supplies the purpose, WebUI method and authoritative positive criterion: enroll a second factor, start a fresh session, enter a valid current code and reach Overview. ED-03/05/06/11/20/30 permit account/role, supported factor, time window, attempt limit, recovery and final state as runtime bindings. A dedicated account and independent recovery make the state change safe, while QR, seed, backup code, password and OTP remain exclusively with the operator and never enter evidence. No speculative negative/expired-code test is added.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2213, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2214 / Wistron-HW-00489-V003 / 8b6c6c611c5f3f9e was directly read from XLSX and its historical record.
Bind exact BMC/SUT/firmware, supported 2FA method, dedicated test account/role, approved authenticator, clock/window policy and final enrollment state.
Verify independent administrator or physical-console recovery before enrollment and define backup-code custody plus maximum failed attempts.
Operator privately scans QR, stores backup code and enters password/OTP; no assistant, screenshot, recording, browser trace or artifact may capture secret values.
After logout use a genuinely fresh session and record only redacted enrollment state, correct BMC/account, successful factor challenge and Overview navigation.
Preserve authentication/audit events and timestamps without secrets; do not clear logs or weaken TLS/session protections.
The source requires one correct-code success; no invalid/expired-code attempt is inferred without separate approval because it can lock the account.
No login, QR display/scan, secret handling, enrollment, OTP entry, retry, recovery or DUT action was executed.

test_case.test_name: Operator-secret-bound BMC 2FA enrollment and fresh valid-factor login validation
test_case.purpose: Verify the approved BMC user can enroll the supported second factor and authenticate in a fresh session with password plus a valid current code to reach Overview, without leaking reusable secrets or losing management recovery.
required_package: Dedicated test account/role and approved final enrollment state
Approved authenticator plus BMC/authenticator clock and allowed TOTP window
Verified independent administrator or physical-console recovery and backup-code custody
Secret-redaction, audit evidence, maximum-attempt and stop policy
test_case.test_command: After owner approval, account/recovery verification and clock check, the authorized operator opens 2FA in the trusted BMC WebUI with all capture disabled, privately scans the QR into the approved authenticator and secures the backup code. Record only a redacted enrolled/not-enrolled state. Log out completely, start a fresh session, privately enter username/password and one current verification code, then record non-secret proof of successful navigation to the correct Overview page and correlated authentication audit events. Leave enrollment in the signed final state.
test_case.expected_result: The dedicated account enrolls the approved factor, a fresh password-plus-valid-factor challenge succeeds within the signed window, the correct BMC Overview opens, audit/session evidence is healthy, no secret value is captured, and independent recovery plus final enrollment state remain valid.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only when recovery was pre-verified, non-secret enrollment state is confirmed, a fresh session actually requires and accepts the valid factor, correct Overview navigation and audit evidence match, and no secret leakage/lockout occurs. Wrong BMC/account, bypassed factor, invalid session state, login failure, secret capture or recovery/final-state failure is FAIL. Missing account/policy/recovery is BLOCKED at execution; QR display or enrollment flag alone cannot PASS.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until exact target, dedicated account/role, supported factor, clock/window, attempt limit, recovery and final state are signed.
Never capture, transmit, store, echo or hash password, QR image, TOTP seed, backup code or OTP; disable screenshots/recording/traces on secret screens.
Do not weaken TLS, disable other protections, use shared sessions or add negative-code attempts without separate approval.
Stop after the first unexpected enrollment/login failure or lockout warning; no brute force, automatic retry, disablement or recovery.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash and BMC/SUT/firmware plus dedicated test-account role
Verified independent recovery and redacted factor-policy/clock/window state
Operator attestation that QR/seed/backup code/password/OTP stayed private and uncaptured
Redacted enrollment-state evidence without secret screens or values
Fresh-session timestamp, successful factor challenge and correct Overview navigation
Redacted authentication/audit events, final enrollment state, discrepancy/recovery and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: On unexpected enrollment/login failure, lockout warning or wrong account/target, stop immediately and preserve only non-secret evidence. Use the independently verified administrator/physical recovery path and owner-held backup code as specified; do not retry credentials/OTP automatically, disable protections or expose secrets during recovery.

source_conflict.reason: The unique source consistently defines 2FA enrollment followed by valid-code login to Overview; missing account/security policy values are runtime prerequisites, not a source conflict.

blocked.reason: The positive 2FA purpose, operator boundary and acceptance are clear; account, factor, clock and recovery policy are runtime security configuration.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: BMC/firmware-supported factor; dedicated account/role; authenticator and TOTP time/window; backup-code custody; maximum attempts; independent recovery; redaction/audit policy; final enrollment state and any separately approved negative test.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED OPERATOR-CONTROLLED SECURITY TEST; RUNTIME SECURITY CONFIGURATION AND USER CONFIRMATION REQUIRED; NO LOGIN, QR/SECRET HANDLING, ENROLLMENT, OTP, RETRY, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: BMC security/product owner, dedicated-account owner and authorized authenticator operator
pending.unlock_condition: Populate and sign factor/account/clock/attempt/recovery/redaction/final-state parameters before execution; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.

external_authorities.authority: Approved ED-03/ED-05/ED-06/ED-11/ED-20/ED-30 parameterization, WebUI evidence, secret safety and no-retry rules
external_authorities.application: Allows account/policy runtime bindings while keeping all reusable factor secrets operator-only and preventing lockout retry.
